title: Bit dependency lockfile (bit.lock)
description: Resolution output for a project's third-party dependencies. This file is machine-owned: it is fully regenerated by every `bit add`, `bit up`, and `bit remove`, and hand edits are not a supported workflow. This schema is for inline typo/corruption detection and documentation, not an invitation to edit it directly. Plain JSON (no comments, no trailing commas), unlike bit.json's JSONC. See spec/SPEC.md §17.7.

additionalProperties.description: One resolved dependency, keyed above by the name it is imported under in bit.json.

url.description: The git remote URL the dependency was fetched from. Omitted entirely for a local filesystem dependency (see `path`), which has no git remote.

commit.description: The exact resolved commit SHA. A tag or branch ref is always dereferenced to its commit before being recorded here — this field never holds a mutable ref. Omitted entirely for a local filesystem dependency (see `path`).

path.description: Present only for a local filesystem / file:// dependency: the decoded path exactly as written in bit.json, absolute or relative to the project root. Mutually exclusive with `url`/`commit` — a local dependency has no git remote and nothing immutable to pin.

vanity.description: The exact vanity path as written in bit.json, without the trailing @ref (e.g. "bitlang.org/pkg/http"). Present only for a dependency resolved through a bit-import: vanity document; omitted entirely for a direct git-host or local dependency.

dir.description: The subdirectory of the fetched repository that is this package's own root (e.g. "pkg/toml"), for a first-party package living in a subfolder of a larger repository rather than at its root. Present only when the resolved vanity document named a `dir` field; omitted entirely otherwise.

requires.description: That dependency's own transitive requirements, copied verbatim from its own bit.json `dependencies` map, so resolution can re-run from the lockfile alone without re-fetching every transitive manifest. An empty object when the dependency declares none.

additionalProperties.description: A transitive dependency's own bit.json dependency value string, copied unchanged (same grammar as bit.json's dependency values).
